$comment: PLAIN-ENGLISH LEGAL NOTICE: Abstract statutory, GAO-audit, and closed-form validation checklist (JSON Schema), NOT an accusation, indictment, or evidentiary filing. Every field encodes a published statutory citation, a public GAO report, a public court record, or a closed-form algebraic invariant.
title: Parens Patriae Capitation Loop & Digital Civil Death Schema
description: Validates governing equations EQ_01-EQ_03 of SPEC-PARENS-PATRIAE-CAPITATION-AND-DIGITAL-CIVIL-DEATH-v1.0: the adversarial fiduciary probate estate-exhaustion function (Fla. Stat. 744.108(1)), the GAO-10-1046 sampled-case loss arithmetic and State v. April Parks sentencing baseline, the Title IV-E open-ended FMAP per-diem capitation asymmetry (42 U.S.C. 670, 672, 673b, 675(5)(E)), the UGCOPAA 312 ex-parte digital civil death latency window (Fla. Stat. 744.331(3)-(5)), and the Marshall v. Marshall 547 U.S. 293 probate-exception plus Younger abstention shield closure.

regime_i_probate_estate_exhaustion.$comment: EQ_01: dE/dt = r*E(t) - F; E* = F/r; t_exhaust = -ln(1 - r*E_0/F)/r. Locked horizon 5.8396 years (billing-discretized); continuous closed-form lower bound 5.6643 years; both inside the [5.5, 6.0] year exhaustion band under a 0.20 year model-form tolerance.

guardian_and_counsel_annual_fee_burn_usd.description: Combined guardian-plus-counsel annual fee burn F drawn from the estate.

exhaustion_band_years.description: Model-form band containing the closed form (5.6643), the discrete variant (~5.79), and the locked horizon.

model_form_tolerance_years.description: Tolerance between continuous closed form and locked discretized horizon.

gao_and_parks_baseline.$comment: GAO-10-1046 (Sept. 30, 2010): $5.4M stolen from 158 victims across 20 sampled closed cases => $34,177.22 mean loss per victim. State v. April Parks, 8th Jud. Dist. Ct., Clark County (Jan. 4, 2019): 192-480 months (16-40 years) imprisonment, $559,205.32 restitution.

gao_2010_sampled_victims.description: GAO-10-1046 victims across the sampled closed cases.

april_parks_min_sentence_months.description: April Parks minimum sentence: 192 months = 16 years.

april_parks_max_sentence_months.description: April Parks maximum sentence: 480 months = 40 years.

april_parks_restitution_usd.description: April Parks restitution order, bounded below the GAO aggregate.

regime_ii_title_ive_capitation.$comment: EQ_02: R_remove = FMAP * c_day * d + B_adopt = 0.65 * 140 * 450 + 6000 = 46950.00 vs. R_preserve = 0.0; dR/d(custody_days) = FMAP * c_day = +91.00/day.

title_ive_fmap_federal_match_rate.description: Federal medical assistance percentage match applied to IV-E maintenance.

custody_days_15_month_asfa_clock.description: ASFA 15-month clock expressed in custody days (15 * 30).

asfa_section_673b_adoption_bonus_usd.description: Adoption incentive bonus B_adopt per finalized adoption.

family_preservation_counterfactual_reven.description: R_preserve: revenue assigned to non-removal kinship preservation.

digital_civil_death.$comment: EQ_03: ex-parte emergency letters (UGCOPAA 312) transfer SIM/2FA/passkey/bank credential custody at t = 0; the Fla. Stat. 744.331(3)-(5) node lattice (5 + 15 + 25 = 45 days) bounds the latency window; L_ward(t > 0) = 0.0.

window_node_days.description: Adjudication node lattice: ex-parte appointment, examining-committee reports, adjudicatory hearing.

ward_post_2fa_lockout_challenger_liquidi.description: Ward accessible defense liquidity after credential custodianship transfer.

abstention_shields.$comment: Marshall v. Marshall, 547 U.S. 293 (2006) probate exception reserves in-rem estate disposition to state probate custody; Younger v. Harris, 401 U.S. 37 (1971) bars federal interference with ongoing state proceedings. In-rem fee extraction => federal review circuit open = 0.

fee_extraction_in_rem.description: Fla. Stat. 744.108(1) fees are drawn in rem from the probate res.

federal_review_circuit_open.description: Composition indicator: 0 for in-rem fee extraction under both doctrines.

proof_contract.$comment: Executable verification contract: the pure-stdlib harness must exit 0.
